territorial_scope.description: Applies to entities within the scope of Art. 2(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 in Poland; individual Commission decisions target named operators; sandbox admission extends to entities without a seat or branch in the EU after EU entities are listed (Art. 95(5)).

evidence.quote: Ustawę stosuje się do podmiotów, o których mowa w art. 2 ust. 1 rozporządzenia 2024/1689

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Polish statute on AI systems that sets up national supervision of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. It creates the Commission for the Development and Security of Artificial Intelligence as market surveillance authority, with inspections, enforcement decisions, notified-body rules, regulatory sandboxes and administrative fines. General entry into force is 14 days after publication.
summary.long: Polish Act of 3 July 2026 on AI systems (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1003). It applies to the entities in Art. 2(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 and excludes defence, national security and certain research activities (Art. 2(1), Art. 3). It creates the Commission for the Development and Security of Artificial Intelligence as market surveillance authority and single point of contact, and sets its composition, appointment, independence and procedure (Art. 5, Art. 19-47). The Commission may run inspections, issue warnings, and order an operator to cease use or withdraw a system where there is a direct risk to life, health, safety or fundamental rights, and it may impose administrative fines (Art. 48-66, Art. 104). Individual opinions and clarifications are available (Art. 8-17). The minister for informatisation accredits and notifies conformity assessment bodies (Art. 86-90). Regulatory sandboxes last 6 to 12 months and carry participation fees (Art. 91-101). Obstructing inspections or not complying with a Commission decision is a criminal offence (Art. 112-113). Other Acts are amended (Art. 115-124), and a state budget spending ceiling for 2026-2035 is set (Art. 126). General entry into force is 14 days after publication, with listed provisions 3 months after (Art. 127).

notes: Relations are those stated in this text. Targets are not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty and target_text identifies them. The footnote to Art. 2 ust. 1 lists the acts amended, matching the amending articles in Ch. 9. Art. 74 ust. 1 contains an undated placeholder (z dnia …). Entry into force is staged (Art. 127): Art. 8–18 and Chs. 3–5, 8 and 9 take effect after 3 months; Art. 125 ust. 4 the day after publication; the rest after 14 days. The text is the original as published (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1003); no consolidated version is shown.
